name: meeting-prd
description: Calendar -> Vexa bot -> Google Meet transcript -> Groq PRD -> Slack approval -> ClickUp tickets

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meeting-prd/core && npm run build -w @meeting-prd/cli && npm run build -w @meeting-prd/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @meeting-prd/core && npm run build -w @meeting-prd/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @meeting-prd/core && npm run dev -w @meeting-prd/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @meeting-prd/core && npm run typecheck -w @meeting-prd/cli
